mint reads NFTPrice to compute required ETH.
mint reads MAX_NFT for the supply cap check.
mint reads maxNFTPurchase for the per-wallet limit.
mint reads listPurchases[to] for the per-wallet mint count.
mint reads ForAllIsActive to optionally bypass allowlist checks.
mint reads root for Merkle proof verification.

mint reads treasury as the ETH receiver.
presaleMint reads NFTPrice for payment validation.
presaleMint reads airdropSupply for the presale cap.
presaleMint reads presaleSupply for the presale cap.
presaleMint reads presaleRoot for Merkle verification.

reserve reads airdropSupply as its cap.

setStartingIndexForPresale uses presaleSupply as the modulus.
setStartingIndexForLast uses lastSupply as the modulus.
mint increments nowTokenId (state write after external transfer and mint loop).
mint increments listPurchases[to] inside the mint loop.
setRoot writes the allowlist Merkle root (onlyOwner).
setPresaleRoot writes the presale Merkle root (onlyOwner).
constructor computes lastSupply = maxNFTSupply - airdropSupply - presaleSupply.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external call.
mint calls _safeMint inside its loop, triggering receiver callbacks.
safeTransferFrom calls _safeTransfer which ends in an external callback.
_burn resolves the token owner via ownerOf.
_approve reads the owner for the Approval event.
burn authorizes the caller through _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId).

mint verifies the allowlist Merkle proof.
presaleMint verifies the presale Merkle proof.
getApproved requires the token to exist.
burn authorizes the untrusted caller via _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId).
reserve mints all reserved tokens to msg.sender.
setApprovalForAll uses _msgSender() as the approving owner.

treasury is the destination of the transfer in mint.
presaleMint performs an external ETH transfer to treasury.
treasury is the destination of the transfer in presaleMint.
